name: In-N-Out Burger "Flying Dutchman" (Plain Meat & Cheese)
whyItWorks: Two fresh 100% ground beef patties (additive-free, ground in In-N-Out's own facilities) grilled plain with two slices of American cheese in between. Contains ZERO bread, ZERO seeds, ZERO fiber, and zero onion/spread irritants.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at drive-thru: "Flying Dutchman, plain, no grilled onions, no spread, salt only." If lactose-sensitive, ask for "No cheese - just two plain beef patties in a box."
